minor.issue: avg_confidence = 93.7 (90D: 92.6) — spec said it should be >= 95 because Tier-3 noise is excluded by the P1 confidence floor. Value is comfortably above the MIN_AGGREGATION_CONFIDENCE floor of 85, so the floor is active and the endpoint is functional, but the >=95 spec target is missed. Likely some Tier-2 (~85-90 confidence) snapshots are still being mixed in. Not a deploy blocker.

rca of the issue: avg_confidence below target: /api/insights/summary computes the mean confidence across all snapshots that pass MIN_AGGREGATION_CONFIDENCE=85. With the floor at 85, Tier-2 snapshots in the 85-94 range are still admitted and drag the mean below the 95 spec target. Either (a) raise MIN_AGGREGATION_CONFIDENCE to ~92 in /app/backend/core/utils.py, or (b) compute avg_confidence over only Tier-1 (>=95) rows while keeping the looser floor for aggregation inclusion.
